issuing_authority: European Commission (AI Office); drafted by independent experts via a multi-stakeholder process
regulatory_regime: EU AI Act (Art. 56 codes of practice)
geo_constraints: Providers of general-purpose AI models placed on the EU market that choose to sign

key_dates.event: Final Code published by the Commission
Commission and AI Board assessment confirming the Code as an adequate voluntary tool (date from general knowledge; not verified on official host)
AI Act GPAI obligations (Arts. 53, 55) the Code helps demonstrate begin to apply
Constitutive meeting of the Signatory Taskforce (per secondary sources)
Commission enforcement powers over GPAI providers apply under the AI Act

covered_entities: providers of general-purpose AI models with systemic risk (Safety and Security chapter)
covered_systems: general-purpose AI models with systemic risk
covered_activities: copyright compliance in training data collection
exceptions: Safety and Security chapter applies only to GPAI models with systemic risk
certain open-source models exempt from documentation commitments in line with AI Act Art. 53(2)
conditions: applies only to signatories; signatories may sign selected chapters (e.g. xAI signed only the Safety and Security chapter, per secondary sources)
adherence may be relied on to demonstrate compliance with AI Act Arts. 53 and 55 until harmonised standards are published
objective: Provide a voluntary tool for GPAI model providers to demonstrate compliance with their AI Act obligations on transparency, copyright, and safety and security of models with systemic risk.
conflict_rule: Non-binding; AI Act obligations prevail. Adherence is a means (not presumption of conformity in the sense of harmonised standards) to demonstrate compliance with AI Act Arts. 53/55.

record_provenance.notes: Official Commission pages could not be fetched. Structure (three chapters: Transparency; Copyright; Safety and Security, the latter with ten commitments) is from general knowledge of the published Code. Clauses are paraphrases (not verbatim). Signatory list changes over time; not reproduced. No revision of the Code after 2025-07-10 was found in searches.

clauses.original_text: Signatories commit to drawing up and keeping up-to-date model documentation (using the Model Documentation Form), providing relevant information to downstream providers and, upon request, to the AI Office and national competent authorities, and ensuring the quality, integrity and security of the documented information.
clauses.action: draw up, keep up-to-date and provide
clauses.recipient: downstream providers; AI Office/national authorities on request
clauses.exception: open-source models exempt under AI Act Art. 53(2), unless systemic risk
clauses.purpose: transparency along the AI value chain
clauses.affected_asset: downstream providers' ability to comply; regulatory oversight
clauses.interpretation_notes: Not verbatim-verified: the official host (digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu) was not reachable from the compilation environment (network policy), so this wording is the compiler's reconstruction of the official text and must be checked against the official source before being treated as a quotation. Paraphrase. Implements AI Act Art. 53(1)(a)-(b) and Annexes XI-XII.

clauses.original_text: Signatories commit to drawing up, keeping up-to-date and implementing a copyright policy; to reproduce and extract only lawfully accessible content when crawling the web; to identify and comply with machine-readable rights reservations (including robots.txt); to mitigate the risk of copyright-infringing outputs; and to designate a point of contact and allow complaints by rightsholders.
clauses.requirement: respect copyright and text-and-data-mining opt-outs and mitigate infringing outputs
clauses.interpretation_notes: Not verbatim-verified: the official host (digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu) was not reachable from the compilation environment (network policy), so this wording is the compiler's reconstruction of the official text and must be checked against the official source before being treated as a quotation. Paraphrase summarising the measures. Implements AI Act Art. 53(1)(c).

clauses.section: Safety and Security chapter, Commitment 1 (Safety and Security Framework)
clauses.original_text: Signatories commit to adopting a state-of-the-art Safety and Security Framework that outlines the systemic risk management processes and measures they implement, to implementing it, and to keeping it updated and notifying it to the AI Office.
clauses.actor: provider of GPAI model with systemic risk (signatory)
clauses.requirement: document and implement a systemic-risk management framework
clauses.condition: model classified as GPAI model with systemic risk
clauses.applicable_systems: general-purpose AI models with systemic risk
clauses.interpretation_notes: Not verbatim-verified: the official host (digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu) was not reachable from the compilation environment (network policy), so this wording is the compiler's reconstruction of the official text and must be checked against the official source before being treated as a quotation. Paraphrase.

clauses.section: Safety and Security chapter, Commitments 2-4 (systemic risk identification, analysis and acceptance determination)
clauses.original_text: Signatories commit to identifying systemic risks stemming from the model, analysing each identified systemic risk (including through model evaluations), and determining whether the systemic risks are acceptable before deciding whether to proceed with development, placing on the market or use of the model.
clauses.actor: provider of GPAI model with systemic risk (signatory)
clauses.action: identify, analyse and determine acceptability of
clauses.requirement: assess systemic risks and only proceed if risks are determined acceptable
clauses.condition: model classified as GPAI model with systemic risk
clauses.affected_asset: public health, safety, security, fundamental rights, society
clauses.applicable_systems: general-purpose AI models with systemic risk
clauses.interpretation_notes: Not verbatim-verified: the official host (digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu) was not reachable from the compilation environment (network policy), so this wording is the compiler's reconstruction of the official text and must be checked against the official source before being treated as a quotation. Paraphrase. Identified risk categories include CBRN, loss of control, cyber offence and harmful manipulation.

clauses.section: Safety and Security chapter, Commitment 6 (Security mitigations)
clauses.original_text: Signatories commit to implementing an adequate level of cybersecurity protection for their models and their physical infrastructure along the entire model lifecycle, to prevent risks from unauthorised release, access and/or theft.
clauses.actor: provider of GPAI model with systemic risk (signatory)
clauses.object: cybersecurity protection for model weights and infrastructure
clauses.requirement: protect model and infrastructure against unauthorised release, access or theft
clauses.condition: model classified as GPAI model with systemic risk
clauses.applicable_systems: general-purpose AI models with systemic risk
clauses.interpretation_notes: Not verbatim-verified: the official host (digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu) was not reachable from the compilation environment (network policy), so this wording is the compiler's reconstruction of the official text and must be checked against the official source before being treated as a quotation. Paraphrase. Implements AI Act Art. 55(1)(d).

clauses.section: Safety and Security chapter, Commitment 9 (Serious incident reporting)
clauses.original_text: Signatories commit to implementing processes to track, document and report to the AI Office (and, as appropriate, national competent authorities) without undue delay relevant information about serious incidents and possible corrective measures.
clauses.actor: provider of GPAI model with systemic risk (signatory)
clauses.recipient: AI Office; national competent authorities as appropriate
clauses.requirement: report serious incidents without undue delay
clauses.applicable_systems: general-purpose AI models with systemic risk
clauses.interpretation_notes: Not verbatim-verified: the official host (digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu) was not reachable from the compilation environment (network policy), so this wording is the compiler's reconstruction of the official text and must be checked against the official source before being treated as a quotation. Paraphrase. Implements AI Act Art. 55(1)(c); the Code sets staged reporting deadlines by incident severity.
